graph_parameters.name: Graph v4 full-path constrained offline pilot
graph_parameters.selection: Exactly the saved v3 20 S0, 33 consecutive S1 P0 F43-75 and 6 stress cases; all 8 saved samples; no new inference

solver.jacobian: explicit analytic for objective and every constraint

graph_parameters.execution: One frozen campaign: 59 single-start sample0 solves and 59 x 8 independent multi-start solves, at most 531 solves. Single and multi have separate consecutive-S1 previous-prior histories. No rerun/tuning/finite-difference solver derivatives.
graph_parameters.nodes: Eight editable SE(2) poses; native XY observation-anchored; auxiliary headings via v3 frozen >=20mm chords. No native yaw/time.
graph_parameters.previous_prior: S1 only, immediately previous accepted constraint-feasible corrected path of the same method. Existing nearest projection at current B, then normalized arclength interpolation of remaining previous path at current native arclength fractions. Weak XY prior, not physical correspondences/timestamps. No previous-prior term for F43, S0, stress or after an immediately previous rejection. Never reanchor previous or FRESH paths.
graph_parameters.se2_residual_variant: Analytic local relative translations and periodic relative/prior heading residual 2sin(delta/2); tangent unit-vector residual. Replaces v3 SE2 log residual representation and weakens prior. Explicitly a new formulation, not identical v3 weights.
graph_parameters.curvature_definition: Signed circumcircle curvature 2cross(u,v)/(|u||v||u+v|), all six consecutive triples; a discrete path constraint, not a guarantee on PP curvature
graph_parameters.boundary_curvature: Freeze original per-sample nearest-projection segment and fraction E. Require forward dot(E-B)>=0.02m and tangent-circle curvature 2*n_B dot(E-B)/|E-B|^2 = previous actual w/v. Reject undefined previous speed; do not replace actual command with earlier counterfactual w/v. This boundary-circle diagnostic is not a PP rollout or a new correspondence search.
graph_parameters.sdf: Precompute signed AABB-union distance minus radius using only geometry public at B. Bilinear values and analytic cell gradients. For all9 samples on every one of7 segments require interpolated clearance - h/sqrt(2) - segment_length/16 >=0.025m, certifying entire segment via Lipschitz bounds. Independent exact segment clearance confirms accepted solutions. Node corridor halfplanes certify every linear segment. No obstacle constraint on B-to-entry connector; full8point polyline safety does not certify connection/PP.
graph_parameters.selection_score: mean squared XY edit from that original sample /0.1^2 + (max(0,0.25-dot(corrected_endpoint-B,forward_B))/0.25)^2; choose smallest score then sample index among converged, hard-constraint feasible and exact-certified solutions. No rollout or future performance in selection.
graph_parameters.sample_selection_only: No correction. Filter original 8 samples by exact full native path >=0.02m and corridor containment using only public geometry; same score with zero edit term, deterministic index tie break. Execute with the SAME variable-speed PP as Graph v4 to separate trajectory editing from speed changes; explicitly not constant-speed sample selection. No feasible original sample means NO_SELECTION, not safe STOP.
graph_parameters.execution_speed: Unchanged v3 dedicated speed rule for sample selection and both v4 variants: target=clip(0.4/abs(kappa_PP),0.05,0.2), acceleration<=0.5m/s2 from previous actual v, omega=clip(v*kappa,-0.4,0.4), continue despite clipping. No zero-speed recovery.
graph_parameters.evaluation: Reuse v3 original PP/control72Hz9Hz, fixed B, actual H_switch or right-censored terminal, H_chunk max60s frozen path without future FRESH/1s expiry. Actual active geometry for post-hoc evaluation. Reuse saved RAW/Speed/Rate/RIGID/Graphv3 results; no v3 solve. No PP computation in v4 objective, constraints or selection.
graph_parameters.acceptance: Native full path AND PP rollout >=0.02m, corridor contained, horizon complete, and valid selected/constraint-feasible converged graph; report progress>=70% RAW H_switch and no stop separately and jointly. Discard old5mm relative loss rule entirely. Failed single final iterates may be evaluated as labelled diagnostics only; no arbitrary multi failure path is selected.
graph_parameters.initial_unsafe: Keep all six stress cases, separately list/exclude three already-below2cm B states in salvageable denominator; no claim of repairing prior violation. All starts still attempted once.
graph_parameters.timing: Report per-start solver wall and initialization/certificate time; single method time and complete serial8start multi-selection time, shared SDF construction separately plus cold-inclusive method time. 20ms target and100ms exceedance proportions, no deadline termination or tuning.
graph_parameters.side_factor: Retain v3 native definite-side rule and sigma0.02m, frozen raw crossing segment/fraction and only public geometry; SIDE_UNDEFINED has no factor.

v5.prior_interpretation: Inherited numerical factors unchanged. Online prior=last accepted corrected path. Original v4 campaign text retained only as provenance; Phase4 top-level rules override campaign/execution descriptions.
